jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Kind Notice:

Do not apply if you live outside of Morocco, your application will be automatically rejected. Thank you for your understanding!

About Us

Where Innovation Meets Excellence!
Agoya is a data and AI agency with a mission: to help clients activate their data and remain relevant in the future. We achieve this through long-term partnerships with our clients where we look to co-create as much as possible towards a shared vision in the future.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Data & Platform Engineer to join our team at Agoya HQ in Belgium. As part of Agoya, you will work on diverse and challenging data and AI projects for clients across different industries.
You will collaborate with our Data Engineers, AI Engineers, analysts, and data scientists to solve meaningful challenges and take reliable data solutions from design to production. You will have the opportunity to continuously learn and explore new technologies.
Beyond project delivery, you will help shape how we work by turning emerging data and AI practices into reusable standards and self-service capabilities across Agoya. This hybrid, hands-on role offers meaningful ownership and the opportunity to make a lasting impact.

Your Responsibilities

Build and operate batch and streaming pipelines for ingestion, transformation, and orchestration.
Design data models for analytics and ML/AI use cases, with appropriate partitioning, clustering, and lifecycle management.
Implement data quality, observability, alerting, and SLOs for critical pipelines and services.
Manage orchestration, dependencies, retries, backfills, and SLAs using tools such as Airflow, Cloud Composer, or Dagster.
Build cloud infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines for safe, repeatable deployments.
Deploy and operate containerized workloads on GCP or Azure while maintaining clear development, staging, and production environments.
Apply least-privilege security, secure networking, and sound secrets management.
Monitor and optimize cloud, warehouse storage, and compute costs.
Translate business needs into reliable data products and create reusable patterns that help teams work independently.
Review code, document designs, share knowledge, and communicate trade-offs clearly across clients and domains.

Are you the one?

3+ years of experience in data engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, or a related combination.
Strong SQL and production-grade Python skills, including testing and packaging
Strong hands-on GCP experience, including BigQuery, GKE/Kubernetes, IAM and service accounts, Cloud DNS, and Dataproc.
Hands-on Kubernetes experience, ideally including self-hosted Airflow on GKE rather than only managed Cloud Composer.
Experience with infrastructure as code, preferably Terraform, including reusable modules and separate development and production environments.
Experience with Docker, CI/CD, and Git-based collaboration.
Hands-on experience with transformation tooling such as dbt.
Solid understanding of data modeling, orchestration, data quality, observability, and operational reliability.
Proven ownership across design, build, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
Experience across different team setups, or technology stacks, with the ability to compare approaches and explain trade-offs.
Experience working closely with data science and analytics teams.
Clear, proactive communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Pragmatic engineering judgment that balances quality, speed, cost, and complexity.
Fluent English is required.

Nice to have

Experience with Dagster or other modern data platform tooling.
Knowledge of governance, lineage, metadata, data contracts, lakehouse patterns, semantic layers, or domain-oriented data products.
Experience with ML/AI infrastructure, model serving, LLM gateways, or self-hosted LLMs.
A relevant cloud certification.
An agentic engineering mindset: turning repeatable work into reliable, tool-using workflows with appropriate guardrails and human oversight.

Our Benefits

Hybrid work, depending on client needs, with in-person collaboration for the moments that matter.
A competitive salary package.
International exposure through diverse client projects across industries and teams.
Continuous learning via internal Agoya Academy sessions and knowledge sharing.
International team buildings and activities, with colleagues across Belgium, Morocco, and Greece.
Real ownership: help shape Agoya’s growth, build lasting ways of working, and leave your footprint on how we deliver GenAI at scale.

Ready to make an impact?

If you’re excited to build reliable data platforms and turn complex data needs into scalable, production-ready solutions, we’d love to hear from you.

Akkodis est une société internationale de conseil en ingénierie numérique (digital engineering) qui accompagne les organisations dans leurs efforts d'innovation et de développement grâce à des solutions technologiques permettant de repenser la conception et l'optimisation des processus et produits.
Fort de nos expertises reconnues en ingénierie, performance industrielle, digital et IA, nous associons solutions technologiques, approches cross-sectorielles et solides capacités d'exécution pour fournir des services de pointe en conseil en technologie.
Avec notre approche Akkodis Intelligence, nous accompagnons les entreprises ainsi que les experts à relever des défis complexes et à obtenir des résultats durables. Akkodis compte près de 40 000 ingénieurs et experts du digital dans le monde.
Akkodis est une marque de The Adecco Group.
Missions

La ligne de service Consulting & Solutions d'Akkodis France renforce ses équipes en région et recrute un Data Engineer AWS Senior / Cloud Data Engineer H/F en CDI. Ce poste s'adresse à des professionnel(le)s passionné(e)s par l'ingénierie de données dans le secteur Healthcare & Medical, avec une expertise avérée sur AWS et la conception de pipelines de données. Vous contribuerez à la mise en place et à l'optimisation de solutions data innovantes au sein d'un environnement international.

Responsabilités principales :

Concevoir, développer et maintenir des pipelines de données robustes sur AWS, en utilisant S3, Lambda, Glue, Redshift, EMR et Step Functions.
Assurer l'intégration et la transformation des données provenant de sources variées, incluant des bases relationnelles, NoSQL, et documentaires.
Collaborer avec les équipes data science et business pour définir et implémenter les besoins en données.
Optimiser les performances et la scalabilité des systèmes de traitement de données dans le cloud.
Garantir la sécurité, la conformité et la gouvernance des données dans l'environnement AWS.
Automatiser la gestion et le déploiement des infrastructures de données via Terraform, Git et CI/CD.
Surveiller et résoudre les incidents liés aux flux de données et aux systèmes cloud.
Participer à l'intégration de solutions IA Générative / RAG (Amazon Bedrock, OpenSearch, embeddings, vector search).

Environnement de travail :

Vous rejoignez une équipe data dynamique en charge d'une plateforme AWS dédiée à la collecte, l'indexation, le stockage et la recherche d'informations pour le secteur Healthcare & Medical. L'environnement international favorise l'autonomie, la collaboration multidisciplinaire, et l'innovation technique. Les méthodologies Agile, la gestion de projet, et l'intégration de sources documentaires complexes font partie du quotidien.

Profil du candidat

Diplômé(e) d'un Master ou équivalent en informatique, data engineering ou domaine connexe, vous justifiez de 5 à 10 ans d'expérience en ingénierie de données ou développement cloud. Vous maîtrisez Python, SQL, la création d'API, ainsi que les services AWS (S3, Lambda, Step Functions, SNS/SQS, DynamoDB, RDS, Lake Formation). Vous avez une solide expérience en modélisation de données, architectures Data Lake, gestion ETL/ELT, et automatisation via Terraform et Git. Une connaissance approfondie des workflows CI/CD, des bases de données relationnelles et NoSQL, ainsi qu'une capacité à intégrer des sources documentaires (SharePoint, GED, bases métiers) sont attendues. Des compétences en IA Générative, machine learning, Snowflake, et un sens de l'analyse technique seront fortement appréciées. La maîtrise de l'anglais technique est indispensable pour évoluer dans un environnement international.

Akkodis accompagne ses clients dans la mondialisation de leurs projets, aussi un anglais courant est requis pour l'ensemble de nos collaborateurs.​

jobs.title: Functional Data Engineer
jobs.description:
At Projective Talent, we connect ambitious professionals with challenging environments where they can accelerate their growth and make a real impact.

For one of our leading clients in the financial services
sector, we are looking for a Functional Data Engineer
who wants to play a key role in a large-scale data transformation journey.

You'll join a modern data environment that is evolving towards a Data Mesh architecture, helping teams turn complex data into structured, scalable and future-proof data products. In this role, you act as the link between business stakeholders and technical data engineers, ensuring data requirements are translated into clear models and actionable solutions.

This is the ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys combining analytical thinking, data modelling and stakeholder interaction.

Your Responsibilities:

Analyse business requirements and translate them into clear data solutions.
Identify, assess and document data sources across multiple domains.
Design and maintain logical data models and data structures.
Collaborate closely with Technical Data Engineers throughout implementation.
Support the development of modern data products within a Data Mesh environment.
Validate delivered solutions and ensure alignment with business needs.
Drive discussions around data definitions, ownership and quality.
Contribute to data governance and continuous improvement initiatives.
Work with a variety of stakeholders to solve complex data challenges.

Your Skills:

We're looking for someone who combines strong analytical capabilities with a genuine interest in data modelling and stakeholder collaboration.

You have/are

A Master in IT, Engineering, Data, Business Engineering or a related field.
Experience in Data Analysis, Data Modelling, Data Warehousing or a similar domain.
Strong SQL skills.
Good understanding of relational databases such as Oracle or PostgreSQL.
Experience with data modelling concepts and methodologies.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
The confidence to challenge stakeholders and drive discussions forward.
Strong communication skills and the ability to translate complex concepts into clear solutions.
Fluency in English in addition to French/Dutch

Nice to have

Experience with Data Vault modelling.
Knowledge of Data Mesh principles.
Experience with PowerDesigner or similar data modelling tools.
Exposure to Data Governance practices.
Experience working in a large and complex enterprise environment.

Who are we?

Projective Talent is part of Projective Group. We do not do things the typical way. We are not a recruiter and not just a classic consultancy firm. We are a launchpad for ambitious minds. You are in the driver’s seat of your career, and we are here to support your journey.

Here is what you can expect from us.
A competitive salary and a flexible mobility budget, including the option of a company car or bike leasing.
Meal and eco vouchers, an individual training budget, and bonus opportunities because we believe great work should be rewarded.
Entry into one of our Smart Programmes, based on where you are in your career and where you want to grow.
A tailored client match based on your skills, ambitions, and personality.
Coaching throughout your journey by your very own Talent Development Officer, genuinely there to help you thrive.
Regular learning sessions, social events, and a close knit community that always has your back.
